body:
## Summary
- make full album stages inherit source album file labels and cover previews unless manually overridden
- persist selected YouTube cover preview data in saved pipeline stages so the tooltip survives reload/app restart
- restore saved album cover previews for both album and derived full-album stages after loading a saved pipeline
- add/update `docs/case-studies/issue-193/` with latest PR feedback, refreshed PR data, verification logs, and root-cause analysis
- merge latest upstream `main` into the PR branch and preserve upstream saved-pipeline thumbnail support

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#193

## Tests
- `npm test -- --runInBand` passed
- `npm run build` passed
- `node --check examples/pipeline.js` passed
- after merging upstream `main`, `npm test -- --runInBand`, `npm run build`, and `node --check examples/pipeline.js` passed again
- after merging upstream `main`, `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` ran with 32 passing and 4 unrelated failures; `keeps saved album cover previews after reload and pipeline restore` passed
